about_the_game:
NOT YOUR AVERAGE NIGHT SHIFT... Clock in for chaos in this demo of Night of the Living Bubble. Experience the first level of the full game, where your store and place of business has been overrun by sentient monsters borne from the products of the shelves. Armed with your trusty-store issued NailGun, it's up to you to clear the store of these monsters.

GAMEPLAY

Run, shoot, bomb and pop enemies as you use everyday tools and appliances to survive and destroy the bubble machines that plague your place of business. Make sure you move quick though as the bubbles don't wait for you to catch your breath in this action packed first person shooter demo. 

In this experience you fight sentient bubble monsters in the store known as 'Rugs Rags and Handsoaps!' Fight using your trusty NailGun, shaken up soda grenades and other home appliance tools as you beat back the horde and begin the first demo-portion of saving the world!

ABOUT THE TEAM

This game started as an project in January 2025 as a part of Global Game Jam. Initially started by a small team of 5 people which quickly became 6, the team have worked around the clock on this project in parallel to class and managing jobs. This demo showcases just a small slice of what's yet to come.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur v. 10.16
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you can play games on it then it will work
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Monterey v 10.17 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Higher
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you can play games on it then it will work

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6600K CPU @ 3.50GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you can play games on it then it will work
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Anything higher than minimum
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything higher than minimum
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you can play games on it then it will work

short_description: NOT YOUR AVERAGE NIGHT SHIFT... When clocking into work, you find that your outlet mall has been overrun by monsters borne from the products on the shelves. Constructed by a mad scientist bent on world domination, only YOU can stop them and save the world by shooting monsters with your Nailgun.
